description: same_person — a weak-band score (0.2415) for the right record against a THIN tree subject: I1 carries one name and one fact, so it scores lower than a fuller person would (0.44 with two more facts), yet far above an unrelated person (7e-9) and well above the Germany-birthplace baptism that conflicts (0.026). Measured live on 2026-10-24 with main's same_person (dev probe, flynn-record-matching). The 0.005 this fixture once returned came from scoring the census's first persona, Thomas, not Patrick. An ARK-less or locally-minted id is scorable on content (dev/probe-same-person-local-id.ts: 0.9999484 against a 0.999967 control), so a missing ARK is never a reason to skip the call.
